answers.p01_answer_001: OWNER INPUT: Luma.Green. The platform owner is the product approver. A team coordinator and working reply contact have not been supplied; research cannot appoint or verify them.
answers.p01_answer_002: OWNER DECISION: the platform owner approves scope and release. Each operator owns its site records. Appoint a qualified compliance reviewer and recovery owner before their services go live. Names and authority remain to be supplied.
answers.p01_answer_003: DEFAULT PRIORITIES: (1) correct India-wide locality and trading, (2) private paper drafts, (3) verified references and acceptance. Research snapshot: 28 Oct 2026. Operator-only evidence is due before each affected service is enabled.
answers.p02_answer_004: IMPLEMENTED WEB PATH: a business member reviews a photographed paper, corrects its text and confirms it. Confirmed text can have separately reviewed manual or optional-model summaries/translations. No automatic stock entry, tax filing or official approval.
answers.p02_answer_005: DESIGN DEFAULT: one JPEG/PNG image, at most 2 MiB and 2400 pixels per side. Keep unsupported documents on the manual path. Language/handwriting accuracy needs real redacted samples and a separately approved model; no universal accuracy is claimed.
answers.p02_answer_006: DESIGN: preserve original bytes/hash in atomic private database chunks; propose plain text and raw date, description, quantity, unit, amount and reference strings. Human-corrected content is separate. No inferred grams/paise, automatic ledger import or official invoice generation.
answers.p02_answer_007: GUARDS: active operators write; viewers read only. Image extraction and text assistance need separate consent. Source, model output and human text stay separate. Bind workspace and saved revision; retain edits and require reload after a conflict. Model text never executes actions.
answers.p02_answer_008: DEFAULT OFF: no paid use without explicit flags and daily allowances. Real redacted samples must prove quality/privacy. Unconfirmed source papers expire after 30 days. Confirmed evidence and derivatives follow reviewed retention; no statutory period is invented. Discard only unconfirmed nonpending drafts.
answers.p03_answer_009: OWNER INPUT: nominate real household, shop, Saathi, yard, recycler, manufacturer, institution and admin testers. Existing 28-participant local evidence is separate from live acceptance. No tester, date or customer identity is invented.
answers.p03_answer_010: TEST PLAN: request->accept->weigh->receipt; offer->payment->dispatch->receipt; job->handover; processing->inspection; recurring visit->shared report->revoke; account removal. Add cross-city, no-shop, expired offer, failure and access-denial cases.
answers.p03_answer_011: OWNER INPUT: approve the actual test window, contact and spending cap. Existing authority does not fund new paid calls. No real-money, OTP or paid lookup is executed by this research; no automatic paid retries.
answers.p03_answer_012: DEFAULT: product owner accepts business outcomes; technical reviewer checks saved state/access. Unverified private access, payment transitions, source integrity, failed recovery or required permit evidence block the affected live service.
answers.p04_answer_013: PUBLIC FACT + INPUT: Convex supports scheduled backups on a paid plan, but this account plan/schedule is unconfirmed. Name a recovery owner and deputy. A local restore already passed; it does not prove the cloud schedule. See source OPS1.
answers.p04_answer_014: PROPOSED TARGET: lose at most 24 hours of recorded work; recover service within 4 hours. These are planning targets, not measured guarantees. Review them against actual operator risk and complete a timed cloud drill before claiming them.
answers.p04_answer_015: PROPOSED POLICY: restricted encrypted off-site copy, separate recovery custodian, daily files-inclusive backup and documented code/config recovery. Exact destination, access owner and lawful retention period require owner approval. Do not put credentials here.
answers.p04_answer_016: OWNER INPUT: approve a separate non-Production restore target, safe data, budget and operator. Restore is destructive at its selected target. Recheck IDs, files, memberships, balances, sessions and schedules; never test by wiping Production. OPS1.
answers.p04_answer_017: EXISTING TARGET: 50 simultaneous signed-in people and 100 requests/day for first acceptance, with ordinary screens near 2 seconds. These are not India-wide capacity claims. Benchmark regional growth, large files and reports before increasing the promised scale.
answers.p05_answer_018: OPERATOR EVIDENCE: supply each real facility, process version and responsible person. Reference stages cover sorting through garments; they are not factory recipes. Use one page per process and keep actual location/material/activity scope.
answers.p05_answer_019: DEFAULT RECORD: list exact inputs, additions, products, residuals and measured losses in integer grams; record money in paise. No universal yield or real batch can be obtained from generic internet examples. Attach actual or labelled synthetic batch evidence.
answers.p05_answer_020: OPERATOR EVIDENCE: supply scales/meter calibration, measurement steps, dates, actor and cost evidence. Every correction needs a reason and audit record. Public rules identify record types, not your actual readings or costs.
answers.p05_answer_021: OPERATOR EVIDENCE: approved contract specification and test methods must set pass/hold/rework/reject limits. Do not assume fixed losses, universal tolerances or certified recycled content. Name the competent reviewer and attach the real specification.
answers.p05_answer_022: OPERATOR EVIDENCE: identify each buyer and permitted residual receiver. Keep agreed quantities, inspection and custody/transport proof. Public lists are leads only; no recipient or signed handover has been verified by this review.
answers.p06_answer_023: PUBLIC FACT: India-wide operation needs the relevant local body/SPCB/PCC and material-specific route, not one national scrap permission. State/city and facility activity must be explicit. The actual site and qualified reviewer are still required. W1/W8.
answers.p06_answer_024: REQUIRED EVIDENCE: actual authorization/order, legal entity/site, category, operation, capacity, conditions, issue/expiry and suspension/revocation status. Retain source and check date. GST or a portal listing alone is not operating permission. W8.
answers.p06_answer_025: OPERATOR EVIDENCE: name the authorized generator/collector/transporter/processor/receiver for each route. Keep batteries, e-waste, tyres, oils, ELV and hazardous waste distinct. No live party is approved by this form. W2-W8.
answers.p06_answer_026: PUBLIC REFERENCE: applicable records/manifest/labels differ by stream and route. Check current amendments and both states before controlled interstate movement. Expired permission or refused receiver must hold the route. An internal receipt is not official submission.
answers.p06_answer_027: KEEP OFF: unverified specialist movement/treatment, official certificate issuance, unsupported tax filing, credit trading/retirement and unapproved regulated partners. The responsible operator supplies evidence before activation; no artificial completion date is assigned.
answers.p07_answer_028: OWNER DEFAULT: shop pays household directly; business buyer pays seller and the disclosed platform fee under the approved policy. Exact fee, fee funder, tax treatment and settlement terms still require the owner/qualified reviewer. No tax rate is invented.
answers.p07_answer_029: EXISTING GUARDS: safe unpaid cancellation; admin-authorized full remaining refund; full eligible returns with evidence. Refund does not itself restore stock. Provider confirmation and approved refund/settlement funding remain necessary.
answers.p07_answer_030: ACCOUNT INPUT: reuse Cashfree, retain separate sandbox/live keys, confirm KYC, marketplace/Easy Split, active sellers and immutable policy. No public search can verify this merchant account. Live checkout remains off pending acceptance.
answers.p07_answer_031: IMPLEMENTED EVIDENCE PATH: keep supplied commercial references and download an explicitly unfiled, reported/unverified CSV or JSON list. Authorized issuers provide official documents. Tax/filing duties, government access and connector-specific implementation still need qualified review.
answers.p07_answer_032: KEYLESS WEB PATH: site owners save/change/cancel a target-plan preference and view history. This is not a paid subscription. Recurring mandate checkout, verified webhook/entitlement producer, merchant approval and tax/renewal/refund terms still need provider-specific work beyond keys.
answers.p08_answer_033: PUBLIC RESEARCH: prepare waste/EPR and carbon project evidence first. Do not operate a CCC exchange or issue official EPR/vehicle/carbon certificates. Lending, insurance and welfare remain partner-gated. See carbon C1-C10 and waste W1-W8.
answers.p08_answer_034: PUBLIC FACT: BEE administers ICM issuance, ACVAs validate/verify, and CERC governs trading channels with registry roles. CPCB/state bodies govern separate waste regimes. No Luma project/account/partner authority has been established. C1/C2/C6/C7.
answers.p08_answer_035: DEFAULT BOUNDARY: Luma records evidence, dates, measured material, claim ownership and review status. Authorized bodies decide registration, verification, issuance and official transactions. Scrap weights, EPR records and impact estimates are not interchangeable credits.
answers.p08_answer_036: DEFAULT PRIVACY: private workspace access, minimum necessary purpose-specific sharing, explicit recipient/expiry and revocation. Model processing requires separate consent. Actual retention/data agreements and approved contacts remain owner/legal inputs.
answers.p08_answer_037: ACCEPTANCE: verify external account/project and methodology, actual facility rights, independent validation/verification and official issuance/registry evidence. No live CCC API/channel for Luma was proved. Keep execution unavailable without those checks. C2/C6/C7/C10.
answers.p09_answer_038: ACCOUNT INPUT: existing Vercel/Convex, OTP and Surepass remain. Configure chosen PostHog, Sentry, R2, Turnstile, Trigger and Geocoding projects using the exact account checklist. No account, region selection or key value is fabricated.
answers.p09_answer_039: DEFAULT: optional services stay off and paid calls stay at zero until their explicit budget/settings are supplied. Paper safety caps: 3/account/day, 10/org/day, plus an explicitly configured global 1-100/day ceiling. Existing Surepass quota is separate.
answers.p09_answer_040: OWNER INPUT: approve each service purpose, region, retention and alert recipient. Keep durable Google-address saving off until permitted terms are confirmed. Public research does not establish your provider agreement or permission for private records.
answers.p09_answer_041: TEST PLAN: operator + technical reviewer check success, timeout, duplicate, denial, consent removal and revocation in an approved window. Provider acceptance is separate from actual inbox/device delivery. No real test attendees/window are invented.
answers.p10_answer_048: OWNER CONFIRMED 29 OCT: finish agreed keyless web work first: plan preferences, reviewed paper assistance, private service replies and evidence preparation. Keep auctions/tenders, predictive/wider ERP, mobile and desktop deferred. Public research does not approve live services.
answers.p11_answer_049: BUILD NOW: India-wide web readiness. Operators enter city and state/UT; households choose that locality before local discovery; eligible ordinary B2B may span cities. Add human-reviewed paper evidence and dated official references. Local availability is not guaranteed nationwide.
answers.p11_answer_050: EXAMPLE ONLY: an active Mumbai shop selects Mumbai, Maharashtra and an actual service point; a local household sees eligible local shops, not Bengaluru quotes. Missing city blocks submission, no local shop yields an empty state, and removed members cannot read private papers.
answers.p11_answer_051: ACCEPTANCE: integrated types/lint/tests/build, local signed-in journeys and current size/theme/script review, then checked PR and backend-first Production release. Model accuracy, paid provider delivery and cloud recovery retain separate acceptance gates.
answers.p11_answer_052: ATTACHMENTS: completed form; India Research and Decisions companion; dated public-source register; existing account checklist. UNKNOWN items are actual contacts, permits/process data, merchant/provider approval and cloud test access. Do not attach passwords or unnecessary personal data.
answers.p11_answer_053: NOT SIGNED: the platform owner delegated research and implementation; no reviewer signature, facility approval, provider acceptance or legal clearance is claimed. Record actual approver names/date and restrictions before each affected live service is enabled.

note: Labelled defaults and public references are not private operator evidence, signatures, provider approval or live acceptance.
